name: genpark-agentic-subscription-churn-retention-negotiator-skill
description: Autonomous Subscription Churn Prediction & Dynamic Retention Negotiator. Evaluates subscriber telemetry (usage drop-off, support friction, billing price sensitivity, tenure LTV), diagnoses cancellation root cause, and dynamically negotiates margin-optimal save offers (subscription pause, tier right-sizing, or loyalty credit).

tools.name: negotiate_subscription_retention
tools.description: Compute subscriber churn risk and LTV, diagnose cancellation reason, and synthesize personalized retention counter-offers.
